image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a brown butterfly (Ringlet) resting on green clover leaves with white flowers in the background. The butterfly's wings are spread open, displaying a uniform dark brown color with distinct rows of small, pale-centered eyespots (ocelli). The body is slender, hairy, and brown, positioned centrally between the wings. Antennae are visible extending from the head.
